input_box_content.user_input_content:
The impact violently throws Riven backward.

Riven loses her grip on the sword.

Her INTACT sword flies out of her hands.

Riven is thrown through the air
and crashes hard onto the dirt.

IMPORTANT:

Riven lands FACE-DOWN on the ground.

Her chest and stomach are toward the ground.

Her back is facing upward.

Riven does NOT land on her back.

Riven does NOT lie face-up.

After the impact,
Riven remains lying prone on the ground,
face-down and stunned.

Her head is turned slightly to one side
so her face remains partially visible.

Her arms rest naturally near her body.

The intact sword lands separately
and slides several feet away from her.

Riven remains conscious but stunned.

Do NOT make Riven roll onto her back.

Do NOT make Riven sit up.

Do NOT continue the fight.

CUT.
